**STEP 2 - Ruler:** Both paper plates look like side plates, about 20 cm in diameter, so each has an area of about 314 cm².

**STEP 3 - Items:** Sweetcorn, carrot, broccoli (left plate); roast chicken and two small boiled potatoes (right plate); a chocolate bar; apple juice in a glass.
